final: WITH pm AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) - AVG(l.TP) as alb_minus_tp, AVG(CAST(l.APTT AS REAL) - CAST(l.PT AS REAL)) as avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sm AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_minus_tp) as sex_alb_minus_tp, AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt) as sex_appt_minus_pt FROM pm GROUP BY SEX), mean_appt AS (SELECT AVG(sex_appt_minus_pt) as mean_val FROM sm), filtered AS (SELECT sex_alb_minus_tp, sex_appt_minus_pt, mean_val FROM sm, mean_appt WHERE sex_appt_minus_pt > mean_val) SELECT AVG(sex_alb_minus_tp) as final_alb_minus_tp, AVG(sex_appt_minus_pt) as final_appt_minus_pt, AVG(sex_appt_minus_pt - mean_val) as final_excess FROM filtered
